meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在 NanoClaw 中会直接从 .env 文件读取你的 Anthropic 凭证（API 密钥或 OAuth 令牌），并将其注入到容器环境中，不再通过 OneCLI 网关。Claude Agent SDK 使用这些凭证来请求 Anthropic API。
howto.when: 当你在 .env 中设置 `NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true` 并提供有效的 Anthropic 凭证，然后重启 NanoClaw 服务后触发。

say.text: 请帮我配置使用 .env 中的 API 密钥。
say.note: 触发技能安装和凭证配置流程。

say.text: 我想改用 Claude 订阅（Pro/Max）而不是 API 密钥。
say.note: 引导使用 OAuth 令牌方式。

howto.what_en: When this skill is installed, NanoClaw reads Anthropic credentials (API key or OAuth token) from your .env file and injects them directly into the container environment, bypassing the OneCLI gateway. The Claude Agent SDK inside uses these credentials for API requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when `NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true` is set, valid Anthropic credentials are present in `.env`, and the NanoClaw service is restarted.

say_en.text: Configure me to use the API key from .env.
I want to use my Claude Pro subscription instead.
